visual.cover_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: TechMind Hub editorial feed cover. Create ONE finished landscape 16:9 raster image, native high resolution around 1536x864. Light professional editorial art, warm ivory #FBF3E6, amber #966020 and deep charcoal typography; spacious, sophisticated humanist sans-serif. The topic is Kimi K3.1 Pro and how control changes when model weights move from a hosted provider to another operator. One sculptural central amber translucent computational module, bridging two distinct architectural settings on a white drafting surface: left a single elegant enclosing amber circular frame, right several separate smaller neutral open frames. This is a conceptual governance metaphor, not real apparatus, not a logo. Restrained thin connections, beautiful translucent materials and soft natural shadows; no sci-fi brain, robot, hacker, padlock, terminal or code text. Main headline in large bold dark letters on the upper left, exact text "Who Holds Control?" Across a single line or two compact lines, dominate the left half; the main object occupies right half and lower middle with ample breathing space. Small category at top "SECURITY & DIGITAL TRUST". Small model label "Kimi K3.1 Pro". Tiny restrained signature "TECHMIND HUB" at lower left. Only these exact text strings. Generous 9% safe margins on all sides, all essential letters/objects survive centered 1200x630 crop from the cover. The short headline must remain legible when image is 260px wide. No graphs, numbers, scientific claims, bibliography, URLs, author names or numbered badges. Do not imply that the model is harmless or that self-hosting has no safeguards.

This must be MOBILE-READABLE: about 50 words, very large explanatory type, absolutely no tiny paragraph text. Essential explanatory letters should be at least 40px high in a 1200px-wide image, no micro-labels. Much smaller title than a poster so body text has room. Clean spacious hierarchy; conceptual illustration, not real hardware diagram.

Top small category "SECURITY & DIGITAL TRUST".
Title "Kimi K3.1 Pro" and subtitle "Capability and control".

"Training intervention"
"Reported reduction in cyber capability"
"An internal test is not a deployment guarantee."

"Hosted service"
"Provider operates the service"
and
"Self-hosted model"
"Operator controls deployment"
